title: The Stranded Merchant
text: A merchant's wagon lies tilted in the road with a broken wheel, its owner sitting on the steps, fanning himself. Fix it, he says, and he will pay well. The wagon's cargo is covered with a tarp. It is lumpy and very still.

options.label: The strongest fixes the wheel, and does not look under the tarp.

outcomes.text: The merchant pays with a fine thing from the back. You do not see under the tarp.

options.label: The Leader buys from the cargo while he is desperate enough to bargain.

outcomes.text: Fair prices, for once. The tarp stays down.

options.label: Plunder the cargo. He cannot run with a broken wheel.

outcomes.text: It is a lot of cargo, and word of it gets around.
